## Escapes and character references

- \[ ] An escaped opening bracket
- [x\] An escaped closing bracket
- &#91; ] A reference for the opening bracket
- [&#32;] A reference for the space
- [&nbsp;] A named reference for a space
- [&#x78;] A reference for the x
- [ &#93; A reference for the closing bracket
- &nbsp;[ ] A reference for a space before the box
- [ ]&#32;A reference for the space after the box

## Spaces only GitHub reads as spaces

- [ ] A no-break space inside
-  [ ] A no-break space before
- [ ] A no-break space after
- [ ] An em space inside
- 　[ ] An ideographic space before
- [] A form feed inside
- [ ] A form feed before
- [ ]A form feed after

## Vertical tabs, which GitHub renders as no space

- [] A vertical tab inside
- [ ]A vertical tab after
- [ ] A box with a vertical tablater on

-[ ] A vertical tab after the marker

## A box, and items GitHub renders as none

- [ ] A box
- [Docs](https://example.com) A link
- [WIP] A bracketed word
- [*x*] An emphasised x
